ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential for Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the 14 high-risk programs and the state's investigation into the matter.
questions: What are the 14 high-risk Medicaid programs in Minnesota?
How much money has been spent on these programs in the past 5 years?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By analyzing data and following the money, we can identify potential areas of fraud and hold those responsible accountable.
